headline: The cart got its counterweight — FLOOR BOSS tail law, measured and mid-flight
lede: Slot a's shift spent itself proving the carts on the warehouse floor were lying about their bodies: loaded carts ghost their tails through rack corners 1,442 times a night. The fix is pushed as draft PR #2768 — loaded pivots now keep the counterweight diagonal clear, landings that break a backswing re-route the tick, and the dead click-refusal that would have been decoration was refused by measurement before it could ship.

notes.text: Tail law in sim.js + painter: bfsKnee never turns a loaded cart into its own tail; repath-on-land sweeps the back diagonal; loaded carts wear a steel counterweight nub; liveTails is the QA eye.

Measured pivot: the placement-refusal half was dead code — the whole-body net equals the knee net on every reachable board (netdiff=0), so the law ships where physics actually bites: 1,381 of 48,041 loaded plans re-routed, 1,442 ghost-clips killed, wins/jams unchanged.
Time-box hit mid-build: draft PR #2768 carries the resume (check gates, two mutants, five honest re-pins). Nothing merged this shift; #2760 keeps building.
Slot-a's dev port was held hostage by a zombie vite from a long-merged worktree (ppid=1) — reaped by hand, third sighting; #2758's process-group reap fix keeps earning its keep.
